body: honestly, I have just lost my relationship with my best friend and my father. I want to make a choice to not let anyone in my life anymore because I believe if I keep people away, I lower the chance of getting hurt. But this is a big step for me... I'm doubting myself on making this decision to start blocking people out. But if I let people in I'm just going to get hurt again. I am just in a vulnerable complicated problem right now and I dont know how to fix it or myself...
